name: Meng zhi Bifang - fate prologue
source:
A young boy named Yan Yuanlan returns to his hometown after many years and transfers to the only middle school in the small town. After eight years, everything in the town has undergone earth-shattering changes, and those lost beauties and precious memories slowly awaken... Is this what they call a miracle? The boy doesn't understand. Afterwards, he reunites with his childhood sweetheart and gets to know the members of the literature club, starting his ordinary days on campus... "She said it like this.
After a moment of silence, the girl had already tidied up her hair, tied her beloved bow, and made an effort to squeeze out a smile as she looked out the window.
"At least for now, it's enough~ Because you have already worked hard and been strong, so there's no need to pretend anymore~"
"Although Nanami occasionally makes mistakes, she definitely loves you sincerely, so please be sure to be understanding towards her."
"As for Mamimi, she is an almost perfect and lovely girl. If you two get together, please cherish her."
"As for Sari... if possible, I don't want you to have too much contact with her. Because her existence itself is a miracle to this world. I don't like her. But... no matter what choice you ultimately make, I will always support and help you."
"And Aisa, don't be fooled by her usual proud and unapproachable demeanor. It's all an act~ Besides, she really loves games and music. If you want to impress her, why not try forming a school band together? I believe that the experiences afterwards will be unforgettable for you~"
...
"What? You're asking who I am?"
"Well... that's a secret~ Just know that no matter what happens, I will always support and help you~"
"I and we will always be waiting for your arrival..."
"No matter how sad and painful reality may be, at least here..."
"In this world full of miracles and hope, all the happiness and joy, all of it, will continue."
"So, it's enough~"
